editions.credit: Gerards meditations, written originally in the Latine tongue by Iohn Gerard; translated and revised by Ralph Winterton, in EEBO-TCP A01645 (the fifth edition of Winterton's Meditations, bound with the sixth edition of Gerard's Prayers), trans. Ralph Winterton (Cambridge: Thomas Buck and Roger Daniel, printers to the University of Cambridge, 1638). Transcription: Text Creation Partnership (EEBO-TCP Phase 1): keyboarded and encoded from page images (CC0).
